the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: By the sheaf-differentials lemma, valid over a field with s, t locally of finite type, the sheaf Omega_{R/U} is free. Over a perfect field, a locally finite type morphism from a reduced scheme whose sheaf of differentials is free is smooth, by Varieties, char-p-differentials-free-smooth. Hence s, t : R to U are smooth. (source lines 1651-1656)
